Homepage: https://3f343.com/
Bilingual pages: https://3f343.com/en/ and https://3f343.com/zh/

Full catalog: https://3f343.com/data/catalog.json
These dates are source catalog dates, not game release dates. AI attribution is source-backed when evidence exists. Listing does not imply independent playtesting. A listed demo URL is not a completed playtest.
